title: Quarterly initiative bundle: Hosted API + Model Catalog operationalization
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Summary:
A consolidated quarterly initiative to operationalize the Hosted API model catalog: reduce time-to-serve new model variants, make versioned model rollouts first-class in the Console, and provide measurable OKRs for latency, cost-per-token, and regression rate. This ticket captures the product-level plan (scope, success metrics, stakeholders, and risks) to coordinate PM, Eng, and Design for 2026-Q2 deliverables.

Background and problem statement:
Teams have repeatedly struggled with ad-hoc model onboarding and inconsistent metadata (capabilities, cost, safety notes) in the hosted catalog. Rollouts today require manual orchestration across runtime and control-plane — causing delays for customers and limiting canary coverage. We need a repeatable, measurable program to: 1) accelerate model onboarding, 2) make rollouts observable/actionable in Console, and 3) tie catalog changes to OKRs (latency/cost/quality).

Scope (in-scope):
- Model catalog metadata enhancements (capabilities, sequence-length profiles, quantization recommendations).
- Hosted API rollout primitives: pinning, canary % routes, automatic fallback mapping to compatible variants.
- Console dashboards for model-level unit economics and regression alerts tied to eval prompt-sets.
- Developer docs and quickstart for partner model onboarding.

Out of scope (this quarter):
- On-prem private deployment integrations (follow-up quarter).
- Deep kernel selection engine changes (runtime will provide recommended knobs, engineering runtime work tracked separately).

Success metrics (OKRs):
- O1: Reduce median model onboarding time from 10 days to 3 days (measure: days between PR to model-catalog and first successful provision in hosted infra).
- O2: Reduce mean tail latency (p99) for standard generation route by 8% for prioritized models (measure per-model baseline vs post-rollout).
- O3: Decrease per-token cost for sampled workloads by 12% via catalog-driven quantization and routing recommendations.
- O4: Prevent model regressions: alert precision >= 90% on eval-triggered regression detection within 24 hours of rollout.

Key stakeholders:
- PMs: Aisha Patel (program), Miguel Alvarez (hosted api lead)
risks: incomplete eval coverage causing undetected regressions
metadata schema changes incompatible with older clients
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (Apr): finalize metadata contract and console surfaces; Phase 2 (May): pilot onboarding flow with two partner models + canary rollout for traffic split; Phase 3 (Jun): full catalog sync and customer communication. Each phase gated by quality checklist and blackout windows in infra schedule.
notes:
Trade-offs discussed: aggressive automation of canaries vs manual safety checks. Decision: automate sensible defaults (5% canary, automatic rollback on regression) but require human approval for wide releases (>50% traffic).
